api.excluded_problem_ids: Unique sorted exact identity strings. Match whole IDs or explicitly verified aliases only.
api.normalized_question_sha256: Unique sorted lowercase hex SHA-256 of each old normalized question.
api.rule: Exclude a candidate if its verified exact ID or alias matches the ID set, or its normalized question digest matches the digest set.

scope: Catalog uses only baseline-commit evidence or individually pinned older source artifacts. No new D4.3 source, labels, or output were read.
D3 known AIME identities belong to 2024 or 2025. D3.9 known formal AIME target years are 1984, 1987, 1991, and 1994. These identified sections are disjoint from the D4.3 2009–2023 range.

Entire previously registered MATH500 and legacy Omni-MATH source pools are included conservatively. Raw old D2 shards and the unselected D3 OlympiadBench source pool are outside the indexed evaluated cohorts. P1 and Phase5C are subsets of the indexed MATH500 pool.

Legacy MATH500, Omni-MATH, selected D2 and D3 OlympiadBench records generally lack verified AIME year/exam/problem aliases. Their exact normalized question hashes are included. A reformulation, translation, or unrecorded source can evade this identity check.
The two 2025 files expose ordered source rows but no official problem IDs. Only source IDs and exact question digests are asserted for their selected rows.
Project historical deduplication only. This artifact does not establish freedom from model-training contamination or semantic duplicates.
